question: Which team won the 2026 League of Legends Mid-Season Invitational (MSI)?
answer: Hanwha Life Esports won the 2026 Mid-Season Invitational, beating Bilibili Gaming 3–2 in the grand final in Daejeon, South Korea, on July 12, 2026 [2][4]. It was Hanwha's first MSI title and the fifth for an LCK team, which ties the LPL for the most wins by a region [2][4]. Choi "Zeus" Woo-je of Hanwha was named finals MVP [2][4].
